budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver all six construction crates while building, sharing, anchoring or drifting real pontoon routes across the harbor channel.
task.natural_termination: Success when all six crates are delivered. Failure when a worker lacks physical support after tide/current update or any crate sinks. Failure excludes success on the same step.
task.interaction: One anchor stabilizes a whole lashed component; releasing it can carry a peer and their cargo to a different row. Sharing, unsharing, lifting and lashing sections change peer movement permissions and connectivity, with a permanent detour and a low-tide causeway as alternatives.
task.observation_access: Fully observable. The role one-hot and public obs_keys vector expose all map/tide state, worker cargo, pontoon positions/holders/owners/permissions/anchors/direct and transitive connectivity, all crate identities, owner depots and events. Deployed and carried sections are actual state entities. Inactive delivered/sunk crate coordinates stay in public accounting but their entity active mask is false. Scene information is drawn from these same leaves.

native_event_definitions.meaning: 0 low, 1 rising, 2 high, 3 falling; three ticks per phase.
Sections physically translated by the current this step.
Lash or unlash command applied at this section this step.
Crates delivered this step by owner.
Crates that lost support and sank this step.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
